The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Plate 11041 of the Russian Lives of the Saints (1903-1911), whose numbering puts it on 4 July - the folder's feast day. Captioned Andrey and filed under Category:Andrew of Crete - the hymnographer archbishop of this folder's office line, kept on 4 July - distinct from the monk-martyr Andrew of Crete (d. 767), whose day is 17 October and whose plate is 02171. Commons describes it: Иллюстрации к книге: Жития святых на русском языке, изложенные по руководству Четьих-Миней  с дополнениями, объяснительными примечаниями и изображениями святых
